changelog: Release pipeline is now repo-URL agnostic. Root cause of the v5.11.0 empty release page: scripts/installer-contract.json hardcoded repo.default to the old repo slug; the drift check in installer-tests.yml fataled after the rename to alimtvnetwork/macro-ahk-v53 and blocked every downstream build/release job.
scripts/resolve-repo-slug.mjs: single resolver (env, git remote, fallback).
scripts/sync-repo-slug.mjs: auto-heals stale literals in installer scripts.
scripts/check-installer-contract.mjs: honors autoResolve and downgrades residual mismatches to notices.
.github/workflows/installer-tests.yml: runs sync-repo-slug.mjs before the contract-drift check.
.lovable/memory/features/release-pipeline-repo-url-agnostic.md: new developer memory + safe-rename checklist, linked from .lovable/what-to-read.md.
readme.md: new 'Repo rename & release pipeline' developer note, 14 install pins repinned to v5.12.0.
No macro-controller or extension source changes.
